scope: Successor local Q-017 observability tranche. Final stdout scalars add particle wrapper-boundary elapsed timers, fixed-record resident-byte breakdowns by species and absolute logical mesh-refinement level, and a direct particle-view allocated-byte snapshot. This record does not claim pure device-kernel profiler timing, total or peak GPU memory, Frontier HIP timing, scaling, or GPU-aware MPI behavior.

telemetry_contract.timer_scope: Timers measure wrapper-boundary elapsed time. Set particles/pic_q017_sync_kernel_timers=true only for dedicated device-timing measurements; the inserted Kokkos fences intentionally perturb execution. Migration call counts include polling callbacks.

particle_memory_contract.level_identity: Keys under particle_memory.level and species-level pairs use absolute logical mesh-refinement levels. particle_memory.root_level and particle_memory.max_level make the range explicit.
particle_memory_contract.direct_view_snapshot_scope: The direct-view snapshot uses Kokkos view span so padding is counted. It includes direct Particles views only and excludes particle migration helper buffers, moment-boundary buffers, AMR/load-balance particle buffers, and allocation high-water marks. It is not total or peak GPU memory.
particle_memory_contract.focused_regression: Two species and absolute logical levels 1 and 2 produce 240 resident particles, a 224-byte fixed record, species counts 120/120 and level counts 112/128.

telemetry_contract.mpi_behavior: Final timer and memory values are reduced to rank zero only. No collectives are inserted into task-list, output-publication, particle-wrapper, or AMR hot paths.
